summary: Read-only backend verification for konsolidasi master data CV. Dewi Aditya (iter 227). Result: 37/37 PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: rahaza_model_variants uses 'active' bool (not 'is_active'); rahaza_boms has both 'active' and 'is_active' - potential drift risk, prefer single source of truth.
rahaza_materials uses 'type' (not 'material_type') for FG marker while BOM item objects use 'material_type' - naming inconsistency across collections.

dewi_rnd_tech_packs for 6 discontinued styles carry empty bom_items but is_latest=True status=draft — acceptable given F_DIHENTIKAN scoping, but frontend/UI must exclude discontinued when computing tech-pack completeness.
test_credentials: admin@garment.com / Admin@123 (rate limit 10/60s honored — token cached at session scope).
seed_data_creation: None. All tests are strictly read-only per instruction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_konsolidasi_iter227.py. Field notes: variants active flag = 'active' (bool), BOM active = 'active', BOM items list is under 'materials', material FG marker is 'type'='fg'. Konsolidasi dry-run runs in ~1 min. When testing API /api/dewi/rnd/tech-packs the response is a bare JSON list (not envelope).
rca of the issue: No production bug. Three initial test failures were harness bugs: (a) regex `E_LENGKAP[^0-9]+(\d+)` greedily consumed the newline+adjacent digit of F_DIHENTIKAN; fixed to `(\d+)\s+E_LENGKAP`. (b) Assertion required non-empty bom_items on all 104 tech packs but 6 discontinued styles are correctly stored with empty arrays; test now whitelists the 6 discontinued codes. (c) tech-packs API returns a bare list; test now handles both list and envelope shapes.
